meta.name: adr-plan
meta.description: Analyze a task and produce an Architecture Decision Record with implementation steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析业务任务，生成架构决策记录和实施方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要记录技术决策并规划实现步骤
copy.tagline_en: Analyze tasks, produce Architecture Decision Records with implementation steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to document architectural decisions and plan implementation

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会分析你给出的任务，探索相关代码库，生成一份架构决策记录（ADR），包含实施步骤。它只做规划，不写代码。
howto.when: 当你提出一个开发任务，要求分析并规划实施方案，或者要求生成一份ADR文档时触发。

say.text: 分析这个用户注册功能的重构任务，生成ADR。
say.note: Claude会分析任务并产出ADR文件。

say.text: 帮我拆解这个特性需求，输出ADR和步骤。
say.note: Claude会生成包含实施步骤的ADR。

say.text: 对当前代码库的改动做架构决策记录。
say.note: Claude会自动探索代码并生成ADR。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes a given task, explores the codebase, and produces an Architecture Decision Record (ADR) with concrete implementation steps. It only plans, does not write code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze a development task and plan implementation steps, or to generate an ADR document.

say_en.text: Analyze the refactoring of user registration and generate an ADR.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and produces ADR file.

say_en.text: Break down this feature request and output an ADR with steps.
say_en.note: Claude generates ADR with implementation steps.

say_en.text: Create an architecture decision record for current code changes.
say_en.note: Claude explores codebase and creates ADR.
